notes: Drawn with north to the LEFT, like 241: Ohio Av. across the top (slanting), Moerlein across the middle, W. Clifton Av. along the bottom; Bosley, Warner and Parker run top-bottom (east-west on the ground). Printed names without suffix (MOERLEIN, BOSLEY, WARNER, PARKER) are written with 'Street'. WARNER here is the 40' continuation of Warner Street east of Clifton (the same street as 240's Warner, which is 40' east of Wheeler); it crosses Clifton (cross, matching 240) and ends at Moerlein (T). Bosley (50') runs from Moerlein (T, Moerlein's north side continuous) to Clifton (T). Parker (50') runs from Clifton to Ohio; the far side of Ohio is not drawn here, so Parker/Ohio is recorded as T (it may continue onto 244). Moerlein's south line jogs at Warner (block corners y~4638 west, ~4516 east); the Warner point is the middle of the open area. Clifton's far (west) line is below the drawn area (only its east line, y~7260-7330, is drawn); points use the printed 60' width (centre ~181 px below that line; the water pipe agrees), so +-15 px in y. Clifton turns at the Parker junction (heading more to the SE on the sheet east of Parker), matching the bend recorded on 240. The single diagonal line from Moerlein towards Clifton through the DUMP (x~2750-4050) is a lot line, not a street. CONKLIN (written 'Conklin Street', ~40' as drawn, lines x~3138/3389) comes in from the 244 side (top) and ends at Ohio's north line; Ohio bends at that junction (about 17 deg below horizontal to the west, about 30 deg to the east), so no separate bend point. Ohio runs off the right edge at x~5470 (drawn area ends).
